Oversee the design, review, coordination, and technical delivery of MEP systems. Ensure MEP designs comply with applicable codes, standards, authority requirements, and project specifications. Review and approve MEP design deliverables, calculations, specifications, drawings, and technical submissions. Provide technical guidance and support to MEP engineers and designers. Ensure effective coordination between Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, HVAC, and other building-services disciplines. Ensure timely resolution of clashes and technical coordination issues. Promote effective use of BIM and digital coordination tools for MEP engineering. Department & Team Management Manage, develop, and lead the MEP engineering team. Establish clear responsibilities, reporting lines, workflows, and performance expectations. Manage departmental workload, priorities, resources, and delivery schedules. Establish and monitor departmental KPIs. Identify manpower requirements and support recruitment and workforce planning. Evaluate team performance and develop technical and professional capabilities. Mentor and develop engineers and technical staff. Build a high-performing MEP organization capable of supporting multiple projects. Project & Delivery Management Monitor MEP engineering deliverables against approved schedules and project requirements. Ensure timely delivery of design packages and technical documentation. Support project teams during construction and resolve MEP-related technical issues. Review contractor and consultant technical submissions where required. Support commissioning, testing, inspection, and handover activities. Monitor MEP-related project risks and ensure appropriate mitigation actions. Cost & Commercial Awareness Support cost planning and optimization of MEP systems. Review MEP design solutions from a cost and value-engineering perspective. Coordinate with Quantity Surveying and Cost Management teams on MEP costs. Identify opportunities for value engineering without compromising quality, performance, or compliance. Support tendering and technical evaluation of MEP contractors and suppliers when required. Management & Reporting Prepare regular reports covering MEP progress, resources, workload, technical risks, and key issues. Coordinate with senior management and relevant engineering functions in Saudi Arabia. Ensure compliance with company policies, engineering standards, procedures, and quality requirements. Drive continuous improvement in MEP engineering processes, quality, productivity, and technical capability. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related MEP discipline . Minimum 15 years of professional experience in MEP Engineering. Significant experience in MEP design and engineering management. Proven experience leading an MEP department, engineering team, or MEP design office. Strong experience managing multidisciplinary MEP teams. Strong knowledge of HVAC, electrical systems, plumbing, fire protection, and building-services engineering . Proven experience in multidisciplinary design coordination. Experience with BIM and MEP coordination is highly preferred. Strong understanding of applicable engineering codes, standards, and authority requirements. Experience managing engineering resources, workloads, schedules, and performance. Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Preferred Experience Previous experience as Head of MEP, MEP Director, MEP Manager, Engineering Manager, Senior MEP Manager, or MEP Design Manager . Experience managing large MEP engineering teams. Experience in large-scale commercial, retail, mixed-use, residential, hospitality, or real estate projects . Experience managing both design and construction-stage MEP activities. Experience working with engineering consultants, contractors, developers, and regional organizations. Strong experience with BIM, Revit MEP, Navisworks, and multidisciplinary coordination. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a senior MEP engineering leader , not simply a highly experienced mechanical or electrical engineer. The candidate must demonstrate proven responsibility for MEP technical delivery, multidisciplinary coordination, team leadership, engineering quality, project schedules, resource management, and technical problem-solving . The candidate should be capable of leading the entire MEP function and coordinating effectively with Architecture, Structural, BIM, Construction, Quantity Surveying, and other departments. Minimum Experience: 15 years MEP Engineering Experience: Mandatory MEP Leadership Experience: Mandatory Department/Team Management: Mandatory Multidisciplinary Coordination: Mandatory Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full-time Workplace: On-site

As part of our commitment to operational excellence, we are actively integrating cutting-edge artificial intelligence to streamline our workflows, enhance compliance operations, and elevate our client service. We are looking for a proactive and forward-thinking Executive Assistant to become a true strategic partner to our CEO; someone who thrives on solving complex operational puzzles, diving deep into business processes, and keeping fast-moving projects on track. Key requirements: • Fluent English - mandatory, additional languages is a PLUS • Must currently reside in Cyprus and hold valid legal right to work (no relocation or visa sponsorship provided) • Experience: 2+ years in EA, PA, or Office Management roles • High level of discretion, analytical mindset, strong organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities: Managing the CEO’s calendar, coordinating internal and external meetings, organizing business travel, and handling occasional personal errands. Assisting with ad-hoc research, preparing presentations/reports, and helping track cross-departmental initiatives. Overseeing smooth day-to-day office management in Limassol, liaising with local vendors, service providers, and landlords, and ensuring the workspace is well-stocked and welcoming for guests. What we offer: Competitive salary and an official local employment contract. Modern, comfortable office in Limassol stocked with snacks, coffee, and refreshments. Growing corporate benefits package. Flat management structure within a friendly, international fintech team.

review_candidates.title: Engineer-in-Training
review_candidates.description: Job Description General Accountability Reports Directly To: Manager, Engineering/Technical Services As a Production Engineer F135, you support planned and unplanned F135 engine maintenance activities. You assess technical deviations, support production teams, and act as a key technical interface between operations, quality, and the OEM. What You'll Do Be the go-to technical expert supporting daily F135 engine maintenance operations. Solve complex technical and production challenges by assessing deviations and determining component status. Translate OEM engineering data into clear, effective work instructions within Solumina. Support and lead technical activities during First Article Inspections (FAI). Drive continuous improvement in processes, reliability, and technical documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and act as a key technical interface with the OEM. What You Bring A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent experience in aerospace or gas turbine MRO. Experience in aerospace maintenance, production, or engineering environments. Strong analytical skills and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset. Confidence in working with OEM documentation and production systems. Clear, professional communication skills and strong command of English. Why join us? Work on cutting-edge aerospace technology with real-world impact. Influence production quality, safety, and innovation from day one. Grow your expertise through continuous learning and improvement initiatives. Enjoy a workplace where everyone knows each other, collaboration is natural, and your contribution truly matters. Work in a friendly, informal, and supportive atmosphere with short communication lines. About Us Raising the Standard of Excellence since 1911 With over a century of proven excellence, StandardAero has become an industry leader in MRO services and customized solutions in the aerospace field. Our shared values and learning-based culture inspire our team to exceed their potential and power our customers’ missions worldwide.

review_candidates.title: Electrical Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview We are a leading company in the electrical solutions sector, seeking to recruit exceptional talents to join our technical sales team. This position aims to bridge deep technical knowledge with our clients' market needs by providing innovative engineering solutions that contribute to the development of their projects and expand our business reach in the Egyptian market. Key Responsibilities and Duties Provide technical consultation to clients regarding electrical products and systems suitable for their needs. Prepare technical and financial proposals and follow up on their cycle until the sales process is completed. Conduct site visits to project locations to assess needs and provide accurate engineering proposals. Build and develop long-term strategic relationships with current and potential clients. Collaborate with internal technical teams to ensure that provided products meet the required technical specifications. Monitor and analyze market trends and competitors, and update sales plans based on the results. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. Proven practical experience in technical sales ranging from 3 to 5 years. Full familiarity with the technical specifications of electrical systems and components. Proficiency in office computer programs and basic engineering design software. High ability to negotiate and persuade using an engineering approach. Excellent communication skills in both Arabic and English. Required Skills Ability to solve technical problems and provide intelligent alternatives. Professional presentation skills. Time management and the ability to work under the pressure of deadlines. Analytical thinking and the ability to perform strategic sales planning. Benefits and Perks A professional work environment that supports continuous professional development. A competitive salary package including rewarding sales commissions. Medical and social insurance. Opportunities for technical training and personal development.
